title: Cornucopias CopiCafe - Episode 1
description:
In this inaugural episode of COPICafe, Cornucopias CEOs Rob Grieg and Josh Jones discuss the latest events from within the Cornucopias metaverse game. Listen to the corn-brains behind it all talk about Cornucopias' latest developments including what happened during the GTI Javelin mint, upcoming projects like the Cornucopias' WIKI page and NFT land plot sale, and how $COPI Token, the flagship cryptocurrency of the Cornucopias project, will soon be available as a Cardano native token. 

Crack open your favorite beverage and enjoy this information-packed chat in the causal, comfy, corntastic first episode of COPICafe!

0:00 - Intro
0:12 - What's COPI Cafe
1:33 - Javelin NFT
3:55 - Racing Track
7:26 - Javelin NFT Sale, What Happened?
15:33 - The Decision
17:22 - Our Community
20:29 - Community Reaction
22:42 - COPI Wiki
32:17 - Wen Land?
37:15 - Cardano Native Token

Be sure to like and subscribe to our channel for more developments from the Cornucopias metaverse project! Also, check out our social channels below:

https://linktr.ee/Cornucopias.Game
